description:
Highlight callouts keep their space as the editor narrows. The commit also highlights src/zeta.ts line 10 with a long comment that wraps onto more lines as the editor narrows. The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} works in a git repo whose top commit, "Highlighted commit", changes src/zeta.ts (line 160 becomes "const critical = true;"), README.md and src/alpha.ts, and carries commit highlights that rank the files zeta.ts, README.md, alpha.ts and comment on src/zeta.ts line 160 ("The one line that matters.") and README.md line 3 ("Docs follow the code."). "The overlay" is the ".diff-viewer-overlay" element; "the files" are the overlay's ".diff-tree-row[aria-selected]" elements, in document order; "the second file" is the one at index 1 (pick it with "nth": 1, scoped with "within" the overlay). Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s).
2. Open the Diffs workspace tool: wait for the ".header" element to be visible, then click the button with accessible name exactly "Diffs" inside ".chat-workspace-actions" (when that toolbar is not shown, click the button named exactly "More options" and then the button whose name starts with "Diffs" in ".chat-overflow-popover"). The overlay becomes visible (allow 30s).
3. Click the second file. "The callout" is the FIRST ".diff-highlight-zone" in the overlay; "the next line" is the overlay's ".editor.modified .view-line" element whose textContent matches /^line\s11$/. "The gap" is the next line's getBoundingClientRect().y - (the callout's y + height), or NaN when either is missing (Monaco re-renders lines as it lays out).
4. The callout is in the viewport.
5. The line after the highlight starts where its callout ends: wait (with an eval that has expect "true") until Math.abs(gap) < 0.5.
6. In one eval (no expect), store the callout's getBoundingClientRect().height in window.__height.
7. Narrow the window to 800x900 (set_viewport with only width 800 and height 900, keeping the rest of the device).
8. Wait (with an eval that has expect "true") until the callout's height is greater than window.__height: the comment wraps onto more lines.
9. Wait (with an eval that has expect "true") until Math.abs(gap) < 0.5 again.

steps.expression: (() => { const callout = document.querySelector('.diff-viewer-overlay .diff-highlight-zone'); const nextLine = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line')).find(l => /^line\s11$/.test(l.textContent.trim())); if (!callout || !nextLine) return NaN; const cr = callout.getBoundingClientRect(); const lr = nextLine.getBoundingClientRect(); const gap = lr.y - (cr.y + cr.height); return Math.abs(gap) < 0.5; })()
